# Total Aggregates take first Astec Frontier screen in UK


TOTAL Aggregates have taken delivery of the first Astec Frontier SF20 Multi-Frequency Screen…


October 20, 2026


Share:


New SF20 Multi-Frequency Screen targets difficult, high-fines materials and screen blinding


TOTAL Aggregates have taken delivery of the first Astec[Frontier SF20 Multi-Frequency Screen](https://astecindustries.com/product/frontier-mobile-incline-multi-frequency-screen/) to enter the UK market. The machine was supplied by Red Knight 6 and is designed for challenging screening applications, particularly materials with high fines content and a tendency to cause blinding.


Astec’s patented Multi-Frequency technology lets operators apply additional vibration to the bottom deck when needed, helping maintain material flow and separation while reducing blinding that can affect conventional screening equipment.


Damian Power, managing director Europe region at Astec, said: ‘We are delighted to see our first Astec Frontier SF20 Multi-Frequency Screen arrive in the UK and, importantly, go straight into a working application with Total Aggregates.’ He emphasized the technology was developed specifically to tackle difficult, sticky, high-fines materials.


Paul Donnelly, managing director of Red Knight 6, said the company had worked closely with Astec on the technology and had already seen its potential. ‘For us, it’s exactly what we want to achieve with Astec – bringing genuinely innovative technology to customers and solving real operational challenges rather than simply selling another machine,’ he commented.


Martin Cox, business development manager Yorkshire at Total Aggregates, said the new machine could improve the company’s on-site screening process, increase productivity and process difficult materials more efficiently.


He noted: ‘We are proud to be the first company in the UK to commission this machine, and it highlights our ongoing commitment to invest in the latest technology.’


The sale follows Red Knight 6’s appointment as an official Astec distributor for England and Wales.


*This article originally published by[Agg-Net.com](https://www.agg-net.com/news/total-aggregates-take-first-astec-frontier-screen-in-uk)*
